name: Crowdin Academic Open License
benefit: Free Crowdin Open Academic License for public educational localization projects, including unlimited project participants.
eligibility: Academic project at an educational institution; apply with an educational email matching the institution's domain.
duration: Subject to the academic license approval and terms; no fixed public term stated.
restrictions: Free Open Academic licenses require publicly accessible projects. Private Academic licenses are discounted 50%, not free; educational use only.
